The '''Tron Boral maneuver''' was a tactic that was utilized in [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]], specifically by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] was known to have used the maneuver.
